updates.text: A transport audit confirmed that Apex Charters does not maintain an operational fleet count of 15 motorcoaches.

policies.text: A shuttle service achieves preferred vendor standing when its quarterly arrival timeliness equals or exceeds 90 percent.
An airport ground handler earns premium terminal access when holding an active baggage handling certification and maintaining a quarterly baggage loss rate below 0.1 percent.
A maritime operator receives approval for international charter operations upon maintaining a certified maritime safety record.
Selection for key enterprise travel agreements requires a transit authorized carrier that maintains minimum indemnification protection of 5000000 USD.

A carrier receives transit authorization whenever fleet volume reaches at least 10 motorcoaches, Gold Safety Transport Accreditation is maintained, or client satisfaction reaches a minimum rating of 4.5 points.
A freight transport company receives priority routing privileges when maintaining an average driver experience level of at least 8 years.
